summary: A carefree invitation to slow down and ride along with a partner, trusting that love will work out.
Boasts about jewelry, a luxury lifestyle and a flashy party life, with a chorus about a partner's diamonds.
A flashy celebration of money, luxury, and sexual confidence, switching between English and Spanish verses.
A couple after a messy argument pleads to meet in the middle and find their way back together.
A boastful dance-craze anthem about devotion, spending money on a partner, and showing off on social media.
A flirtatious party-life narrator says they need a girl who likes fun and loves living like they do.
Calls out a partner who only shows off online and asks what they can really offer, then insists on living for the club.
A heartbroken narrator still sees a former lover everywhere, struggling to move on after being left behind.
Insists to an ex that they are better now, while admitting regret over the breakup and past loyalty.
A chorus-driven brag about looking flashy and stylish with a partner, leaning on luxury and confidence.
A remix about a new romance that makes the narrator feel anxious and giddy, with a heartbeat chant.
A woman sets out numbered rules to stop calling, letting in, or befriending an ex who keeps pulling her back.
A hurting narrator describes feeling lost, afraid of letting go, and sad after being left, with dark thoughts of self-harm.
Describes being hopelessly addicted to a lover, comparing them to drugs and promising the bond changes them forever.
A romantic, sensual R&B track asking a partner to reveal their feelings and commit for the whole summer.
A bouncy anthem about moving past pain, staying happy, and living for the moment without crying anymore.
Declares a lover's devotion in a sensual, hook-driven song about claiming a partner for a night and beyond.
A Memphis rapper warns rivals to stay alert as he celebrates his rise, rough past, and gang loyalty.
A nervous, flirtatious narrator meets someone at a bar, admitting they like each other while worrying the romance is fragile.
Two rappers boast about their rise, money, cars, and loyalty to their crew, with a hook about spending it all.
An exasperated narrator insists a flirtatious ex is just a friend and refuses to reconcile, spelling it out.
A confessional narrator admits being bad at love, mixing cheerful memories of exes with jealousy and self-doubt.
Brags about status, cars, jewelry and women, with a repeated hook that says whether they can get a taste.
Apologizes to a partner in an escalating breakup, feeling let down and walking away from a draining relationship.
A raunchy party rap about money, sex, fame and rolling with a crew, with a chorus about getting money from fans.
Brags about crew loyalty, violence and sexual boasting, with a hook saying the narrator wants no friends.
A country ballad where a tequila taste brings back memories of a lost love, leaving the narrator still longing.
Trio of rappers boast about luxury cars, jewelry, money and sexual power, dismissing rivals and haters.
A young person in New York says they feel better about themselves when with a partner, wanting to stay close.
A live-show anthem about an on-off partner who keeps pulling away, leaving the narrator feeling like a dead man walking.
A driven narrator pushes through pressure and self-doubt, accepting whatever it takes to chase the adrenaline of success.
Flaunts expensive jewelry, cars and luxury style while threatening rivals and boasting about gang loyalty.
Heartbroken after a partner rejected and cheated on him, the narrator spirals and drowns his sorrows in liquor.
A reflective prayer-like plea asking who will save the narrator from war, pain and violence across a troubled world.
After a breakup, the narrator admits still thinking of an ex and would go back to them if given another chance.
A high-energy trap track about flying private, partying, chasing money and women, and staying in a wild mood.
A flashy trio boast about living the walk they talk, from money and jewelry to loyalty and rising from the streets.
Trap-style boasts about designer fashion, cocaine, shooters and a Gucci crew, mixing English and Spanish verses.
A couple swear loyalty to each other through a wild, criminal love, claiming they will stay together until the end.
A distressed narrator says the walls are closing in, struggling with anxiety and dark thoughts while asking for help.
A reflective song about love and fear of getting hurt, with the narrator swearing off ego and hoping for a dream.
A flashy trap hook about cooking up money in the kitchen, with boasts about jewelry, cars and rivals.
Asks a partner to love him for who he is, with flirtatious promises and a summer-party romance that could last forever.
A stark critique of American violence and racism, contrasting joyful dance with gun crime and urging Black men to get money.
Boasts about rising to the top, staying on top of rivals, and building a fortune while staying loyal to the crew.
A love song saying a partner is perfect, that nothing could be better than this moment, even heaven.
A comedic rap where the narrator swaps bodies with celebrities and jokes about wild situations, feeling absurd and crude.
Gritty New York street rap about guns, money, crew loyalty, and contempt for women and rivals.
Flashy drug-kingpin boasts about a plug, luxury coupes, gang loyalty and money, with Spanish-language ad-libs.
A sung apology to a partner who has grown tired of the narrator, begging to be given another chance to make things right.
